name: Subby's Plushies & Essentials
notes: Clean V4 rebuild baseline for Heartkeeper's Lantern.
Uses one permanent native Glow color layer instead of overlay or toggle-driven glow logic.
Keeps the lantern's 10 color rows with Glow as the 10th row.
Keeps lantern layers at priority 25 and the Glow layer at priority 26.
Built as the clean baseline for the next Halo-style light-bloom pass.
